milestone: The most important milestone is to hire an industrial designer to create a non-functioning prototype of a supplemental nursing system. This will be a novel device that provides supplemental formula or breastmilk to infants directly at the breast, training the baby to breastfeed while simultaneously stimulating mother to produce more milk. We will use this non-functioning prototype to garner feedback from 15-20 NICU nurses and managers.
metrics: 1 industrial designer hired, 1 non-functioning prototype, 15-20 NICU nurses/managers interviewed
